not_usable.reason: T1 (2 records) and two single-sample T2* values are recorded. T2 and the full T2* data are NOT recorded: they are given only as fit equations and figures. R2 (sec-1) = 3.9 + 55 [(1 - Y') - 0.05]^2 for Hct ~0.30 (Eq. 12) and R2 (sec-1) = 6.2 + 59 [(1 - Y') - 0.05]^2 for Hct ~0.40 (Eq. 13), Hahn spin echo, 1.5 T, 37 C. R2* = R2*,min + K(TE,Hct) [(1 - Y') - 0.05]^2 with Table 1 parameters (for example TE 18 msec: R2*,min 4.37 sec-1, K 93 sec-1 at Hct 30%; 4.92 sec-1, 108 sec-1 at Hct 39%), plus a Gaussian term. Measured points are in Figs. 2, 4 and 5 only. Plasma values (R1 0.49 ± 0.04 sec-1, R2 2.0 ± 0.2 sec-1) are not whole blood and are not recorded.

Chen JJ, Pike GB. Magn Reson Med 2009;61:249-254 (PMID 19165880). Human whole blood T2 at 3 T, in vitro (venous samples from 10 healthy subjects, heparin syringes, 20.1 ± 2.2 C, Hct 42 ± 4%, Y from 20% to 98%, 13 CPMG refocusing intervals from 2 to 37.5 msec). The measured T2 values for each oxygenation level are only in Fig. 1. The text and Table 1 give model fit parameters only: intrinsic T2,0 = 186.1 ± 27.0 msec (unconstrained diffusion model, group mean ± SD) and 174.5 ± 15.4 msec (constrained exchange model), with G0 = {(7.52 ± 1.26) x 10^-13 (1 - Y)^2 + (2.60 ± 2.71) x 10^-14} T^2 and rc = 2.73 ± 0.03 um. These are model parameters at room temperature, not measured T2 values at a stated oxygenation. The 1.5 T column of Table 1 is from an earlier paper (their Ref. 11).
